results.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your arms by your sides with palms facing down for stability.
Lift your legs off the floor, bending your knees at a 90-degree angle so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and your calves are parallel to the floor.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, curling your knees towards your chest. Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your hips.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position, keeping your knees bent at a 90-degree angle. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum to lift your hips; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them back down.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor to avoid straining your neck.
results.description: Reverse Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Reverse Plank
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your chest open.
Hold the position for the set time, then lower with control.
tips: Don't let your hips drop.
Keep your neck in line with your body; look up rather than letting your head hang back.
results.description: Reverse Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Shoulders, Triceps.

results.name: Russian Twist With Medicine Ball
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels on the ground, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to bring the ball beside one hip.
Rotate back through the centre to the other side and repeat.
tips: Lift your feet to make it harder.
Keep your chest open and turn your shoulders.
results.description: Russian Twist With Medicine Ball is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Lean back slightly so that your torso forms a V-shape with your thighs.
Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing your hands opposite your right hip.
Rotate back through the center and to the left, bringing your hands opposite your left hip. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move your torso, not just your arms, to ensure you are engaging your oblique muscles.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you rotate to each side and inhaling as you return to the center.
Keep your back straight and avoid hunching your shoulders to maintain proper form.
results.description: Russian Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Scissors Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Lift both legs off the floor a few inches, keeping them straight.
Alternately cross your legs over each other in a scissor-like motion. Move your right leg over your left leg and then switch, bringing your left leg over your right leg.
Continue alternating legs in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
tips: Ensure your lower back remains pressed against the floor to avoid strain and maintain proper form.
Move your legs slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
Avoid letting your legs drop too low, which could increase strain on your lower back.
results.description: Scissors Kick is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Seated Flutter Kicks
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs extended straight out in front of you. Lean back slightly, supporting yourself by gripping the sides of the bench.
Lift both legs off the bench a few inches, keeping them straight.
Begin the flutter kicks by alternately raising and lowering your legs in a scissor-like motion, moving your right leg up while your left leg moves down and vice versa.
Continue the flutter kicks for the desired number of repetitions or duration, keeping your core engaged and your movements controlled.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders to maintain proper form.
Perform the exercise on a stable, non-slip bench to ensure safety and prevent slipping.
If you are new to this exercise, start with a smaller range of motion and gradually increase it as you build strength.
results.description: Seated Flutter Kicks is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Seated V Up
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your arms placed on the floor slightly behind you for support.
Engage your core and lift your torso off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest to form a V shape with your body.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Lower your legs and torso back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift into the V position and inhaling as you lower back down.
Avoid using momentum to lift your legs and torso; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders to maintain proper form.
results.description: Seated V Up is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Side Plank Oblique Crunch
instructions: Begin in a side plank position on your right side, with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder. Place your left hand on your hip.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your feet.
Lower your hips towards the floor without touching it, then raise them back up to the starting position, squeezing your obliques at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other side and perform the exercise on your left side.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain balance and stability.
Move your hips slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them.
results.description: Side Plank Oblique Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders.

results.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your right side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold the position for the desired duration, keeping your body straight and your core tight.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat on the other side by lying on your left side and following the same steps.
tips: Ensure your elbow is directly under your shoulder to support your upper body.
Focus on keeping your head in line with your spine to prevent neck strain.
Maintain a straight body line, avoiding any sagging or lifting of the hips.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
results.description: Side Plank is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

results.name: Spider Plank
instructions: Begin in a standard plank position with your forearms on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core and keep your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right foot off the floor and bring your right knee towards your right elbow, keeping your hips level and your core tight.
Return your right foot to the starting position, maintaining a stable plank position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, bringing your left knee towards your left elbow. Continue alternating legs for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Focus on keeping your hips level and avoiding excessive torso rotation.
Use a mat to cushion your forearms and feet for added comfort.
results.description: Spider Plank is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes, Hip Flexors.
